flow_ref: ACM_FSD _v1.2.pdf section 1.5 (p.12, wins); ACM_Functional_Document_v1.0.pdf section 8 (p.9-11); HCL_CAC.pptx (images only, high-level, no function-level detail).
code_summary: Manage Function exists end-to-end: UI in ManageFunctions/ (Function*.js) uses redux-saga to FunctionController (/acm/v1/function/*), FunctionService, the ACM_FUNCTION entity, plus audit through FunctionTransactionService. Gaps: no sort, edit is not limited to description, the AC-ADMIN restriction exists only in the UI menu, generic error modal.
note: Baseline: code zip snapshot (git commit 90482ed from git rev-parse). FSD v1.2 wins over Functional Document v1.0. HCL_CAC.pptx is high-level images only and gives no function detail. Later decks are unknown. Field length limits (name/ID 100, description 200) exist only in the UI; backend accepts description up to 256. Delete is a hard delete cascading to role-function mappings.
recommendation: Fix before claiming full coverage: add an AC-admin role check in FunctionController, limit update to description (or confirm with the FSD owner that URL may change), add sort, and show the backend error message in the modal.

steps.step: Staff signs in and reaches ACM only if they hold an ACM role
steps.detail: PrivateRouteACMConfig (PrivateRouteConfig.js:10-33) only lets route /acm/manage-function (RoutesConfig.js:141-146) through when the user has ACM application access in LoginUserRoleState; otherwise it redirects to "/". AAD / Staff Portal authentication is not visible in this repo: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Only AC-ADMIN staff should manage functions
steps.detail: The Application Module dropdown shows "Manage Function" only when the user role list contains AC-admin (LayoutACM.js:49-54, constant.js:16 accessRole). But the route /acm/manage-function only checks ACM access (PrivateRouteConfig.js:21-33), and FunctionController.java:22-61 has no role check; WebSecurityConfig.java:124 and :167 use permitAll. So the AC-ADMIN restriction exists only in the UI menu, not in the API.

steps.step: Table lists application, module, function name and ID
steps.detail: The dropdown dispatches getFunctionList (ACM/index.js:68) -> FunctionsSaga.js:17 POST acm/v1/function/viewFunctions -> FunctionController.java:44-51 -> FunctionService.getFunctions (FunctionService.java:97-104, findAll). The DataTable shows Application ID, Module ID, Function Name, Function ID, Action (constant.js:87-93). There is no status column; delete is a hard delete (FunctionService.java:119), so "except deleted" holds by itself.

steps.step: Search, sort and export the function list
steps.detail: Search exists: SearchBox (FunctionTableView.js:28) -> POST viewFunctions with searchText -> FunctionService.searchFunction (FunctionService.java:144-153, containing ID or Name). Export exists: ExportToExcel (FunctionTableView.js:41-45, Functions.csv, holds the currently loaded list; CSV format, not .xlsx). Sort: no sort code found in DataTable.js or in the backend query.

steps.step: Add New Function opens the form with all fields
steps.detail: The Add New Function button (FunctionTableView.js:38) -> showDataTablePage isNew (FunctionTableView.js:14-16) loads FunctionAddEdit.js:29-42 with Application and Module dropdowns, Function Name, Function ID (maxlength 100), URL (maxlength 100), Description (maxlength 200, optional). Yup validation in SechmaValidation.js:31-43 (all required except description, URL uses a regex). Note: backend FunctionCreateRequest.java accepts description up to 256 and has no @Size for name/ID, so the 200/100 limits are enforced in the UI only.

steps.step: Submit creates the function in the database
steps.detail: ACM/index.js:206-226 builds the payload -> FunctionPostSaga.js:24 POST acm/v1/function/createFunction -> FunctionController.java:29-32 -> FunctionService.createFunction (FunctionService.java:64-73): rejects an existing functionId (ACMEntityAlreadyExistsException, 400), looks up the module, saves to ACM_FUNCTION (Function.java:17). Audit: FunctionTransactionService.java:37-43 stores a copy in the transaction table after create.

steps.step: Edit should change the description only
steps.detail: FSD: edit allows description only. In the UI during edit, Application, Module, Function Name and Function ID are disabled (FunctionAddEdit.js:29-32), but URL can be edited through its edit button (FunctionAddEdit.js:33-40, isEditConfirm). Backend FunctionService.updateFunction (FunctionService.java:75-88) overwrites functionName, description and functionUrl without checking what changed, so the API accepts a new name and URL. Functional Document p.10 only locks Application, Module, Name and ID, so URL is editable per that deck; FSD v1.2 wins.

steps.step: Delete asks for confirmation, then removes the function
steps.detail: The delete icon (DataTable.js:369-374) -> handleRemove (DataTable.js:174-183) opens the ConfirmModal DeleteContent (ConfirmModal.js:98-117). After confirmation, handleDelete (DataTable.js:185-195) -> DeleteFunctionSaga.js:19 POST deleteFunction -> FunctionService.deleteFunction (FunctionService.java:116-123). Note: this is a hard delete (removeByFunctionId) and Function.java:42 has cascade ALL + orphanRemoval to RoleFunction, so role-function mappings are removed too; before that FunctionTransactionService.java:100-113 stores a copy of the function and role-function rows in the transaction table.

steps.step: No approval for create, update or delete
steps.detail: createFunction, updateFunction and deleteFunction (FunctionController.java:29-37, 53-56) write straight to ACM_FUNCTION through FunctionService with no pending status or approver step; the Function.java entity has no status column. FunctionTransactionService only records history.

The axios interceptor (axios.configuration.js:43-47) sets apiError for 404/500 and apiError400 for 400; ContentLayout.js:11-15 shows a Modal with generic text ("We are unable to display the requested page..." / "...retrieve the record..."). The specific backend message (e.g. "function already exists") is not shown; the functionState.error state in FunctionsReducer.js:33-37 is read by no component. Other statuses (e.g. 401) show no modal.
